hits.title: EverCommerce Appoints Amy Guggenheim Shenkan to Its Board of Directors
hits.snippet: [hires | 2025-05-20] EverCommerce Inc. hired Amy Guggenheim Shenkan as Board of Directors on May 20th '25. DENVER, May 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - EverCommerce Inc. (Nasdaq: EVCM) (the "Company"), a leading provider of SaaS solutions for service SMBs, announced today the appointment of Amy Guggenheim Shenkan to its Board of Directors.
